note: bug_260703_0038 (Alpha Integrated Systems Ltd., invoice 132721): the invoice carries BOTH a Sold-to block (8631 Alexandra Road, Richmond BC V6X 1C3 -- the serviced property) and a Ship-to block holding Noble's OWN head office (Unit 155 - 13988 Maycrest Way). The service_address prompt ranks SHIP TO above SOLD TO, so both twins returned the head office confidently and identically on every replicate (extract 0.744/0.829/0.781, generate 0.902/0.896/0.886) -- twin resolution cannot help when the twins agree on the wrong block. This doc anchors that service_address resolves to the Sold-to address instead, via the Bill To rescue (resolutions.service_address.source = 'bill_to_fallback'). The fix is CODE-ONLY -- gates.evaluate rejects a service_address that is Noble's own office and falls back to bill_to_address. The analyzer prompt is deliberately untouched: a blacklist sentence was written, measured, and reverted because it destabilised service_address on 260629_0010 (3/15 runs blank vs 0/13 at HEAD) while adding nothing here. Verified live 3/3 with the unmodified prod prompt. routingDecision REVIEW_B4_CRITICAL_FIELD is CORRECT and unrelated to this bug: the invoice prints no PO/job number ('Re: Order No.' is blank) and po_or_job_number is commercial-critical. total 178.50 = Amount Owing (Amount Paid 0.00); line item 170.00 + GST 8.50, so amount_excluding_gst 170. No PO -> sub_bill_type falls back to 'other'. billing-period fields blank (one-time service call, no period printed) -- asserted blank to guard against a generate twin inventing one. Values verified against the PDF 2026-07-31. || NOT asserted here: payment_due_date (none printed, so it takes the today+30 DEFAULT -- asserting the observed '2026-08-30' would go red the next day); invoice_description (drifts run-to-run: 'Security equipment service call' vs 'Commercial security service call'); po_or_job_number and account_number (none printed).
